svg.title: Blue Ripe
svg.desc: Interpretive hand-authored study after visual inspection of the1996 Guggenheim retrospective plate. Approximate geometry; standardized vivid palette. Texture, mounting shadows and perspective omitted. Blue rounded figure is painted on a white square canvas, not a shaped monochrome. Original plate and Voorlinden founder interview confirm the square support; narrow white margins are approximate.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://archive.org/download/ellswo00kell/ellswo00kell.pdf#page=143; catalogue 36; visually inspected2026-10-27. Interpretive study, not facsimile.
